== English Official Tournament Sealed Deck comparison ==
The complete published 2016 wording specifies the once-per-turn target selection and its duration. It expresses the veteran condition directly as a Rebel leader or non-recruit trooper. Free deployment, non-unique Rebel warrior target and satisfaction of remaining attrition are retained. The Players Committee describes this as a clarification. Both the marked full image and printable slip match the announcement. The pinned machine record leaves the clauses in a different order and retains the earlier ‘veteran’ label.
